name: gVisor
description: An application kernel that provides a strong isolation boundary for containers.
summary: gVisor allows AI tools for contributions, including code, tests, docs, and assets, but requires human oversight: a person must thoroughly review all AI-generated content before submission, remain the sole author, and take responsibility for the work. Autonomous AI agents may not open pull requests or push changes.

evidence.quote: This policy ensures that AI-generated contributions are always guided, validated, and owned by a skilled human, promoting better software and a stronger community than policing how code gets written.
While contributors can use any AI tools to create their contributions, human oversight is mandatory.
All AI-generated content must be thoroughly reviewed by the contributor before being submitted for review.
The contributor remains the sole author and is fully responsible for the contribution’s accuracy, quality, and maintainability.
AI should augment your abilities, not replace your critical judgment.

Contributors should ensure their work meets a high standard before seeking review, respecting maintainers’ time, and must be prepared to discuss and justify their contributions during the review process.
